title: You write one kind sentence. I donate a dime. A blockchain makes sure I do.
why_read: A small blockchain memo-chain novelty project for tracking kindness pledges, technically simple and more of a charity gimmick than a substantial engineering piece.
analysis: Kindness Chain uses Solana devnet SPL Memo transactions to create a chained, publicly verifiable feed of 'kind sentences,' with a charitable donation tied to each entry. Technically it's a thin wrapper around existing blockchain memo functionality with no real novel engineering, more notable as a feel-good weekend hackathon project than a piece with lasting technical value. Readers interested in blockchain use-cases beyond finance might find it a mildly interesting toy example.
